description: TY2025: the SS 1(g) kiddie tax, full Form 8615 path. Child (single, claimed as dependent): $3,000 wages + $5,000 interest. Dependent std deduction = max(1,350, 3,000+450) = 3,450 -> TI 4,550. NUI = min(5,000 - 2,700, TI) = 2,300. Child regular tax (Table mid 4,575) = 458; tax on TI-NUI = 2,250 (mid 2,262.50) = 226. Parent (MFJ, TI 250,000, no preferential income): T(252,300) = 46,246 minus T(250,000) = 45,694 -> allocable parental tax 552. Greater of 458 vs 226+552 = 778 -> the override replaces the child's income tax. Net $778.00.
